resolved.title: const
resolved.description:
[s0l0!-header][h1]const[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

[b]const [/b]variables have the same scope as variables declared using [b]let[/b]. The difference is that const variables are [b]immutable [/b]- they are not allowed to be reassigned.
For example, the following generates an exception: [code format="js" codeId="1418"][b]const[/b] a = 'Hello';
a = 'Bye';[/code]
[note][b]const [/b]is not subject to [b]Variable Hoisting [/b]too, which means that [b]const [/b]declarations do not move to the top of the current execution context.
Also note that ES6 code will run only in browsers that support it. Older devices and browsers that do not support ES6 will return a syntax error.[/note]
resolved.description_en:
[s0l0!-header][h1]const[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

[b]const [/b]variables have the same scope as variables declared using [b]let[/b]. The difference is that const variables are [b]immutable [/b]- they are not allowed to be reassigned.
For example, the following generates an exception: [code format="js" codeId="1418"][b]const[/b] a = 'Hello';
a = 'Bye';[/code]
[note][b]const [/b]is not subject to [b]Variable Hoisting [/b]too, which means that [b]const [/b]declarations do not move to the top of the current execution context.
Also note that ES6 code will run only in browsers that support it. Older devices and browsers that do not support ES6 will return a syntax error.[/note]

给定程序输入两个字符串：国家和首都名。
完善函数`countryCard（）`，参考示例输出，返回一个字符串。
resolved.problem_statement_en_md:
[s0l0!-header][h1]ES6 Variables and Strings[/h1][/s0l0!-header]

You need to make country cards for a school project.
The given program takes the country and its capital name as input.
Complete the function to return a string in the format you are given in the sample output:

[b]Sample Input[/b]
Portugal
Lisbon

[b]Sample Output[/b]
Name: Portugal, Capital: Lisbon

[note]Use template literals to output variables in strings.[/note]
